scene1Childhood.memory: When I was eight I wore my sunglasses everywhere and told everyone I am a scientist. My sister rolled her eyes and said you are eight. I said a scientist, not even kidding. Mom just said then go do science, habibi.

scene5LegacyFinale.memory: My mom never once laughed at me, even when I was ridiculous. Good people can still do bad things, and you can still love them. You are what you think about, sunglasses kid.
